owners.runtime: Hermes owns background reviews, models, tools, learning stores and mutation/cache lifecycle.
owners.knowledge: This Codex skill is context, not a Herdr Memory engine. Native Codex and existing common/domain Memory owners retain their stores and admitted readers.

officialGuidance.qualification: Partial official-page guidance, not a version-pinned manual. Use the existing Runtime Index and compare the installed source/settings before applying it.
officialGuidance.meaning: Post-turn self-improvement may update skills; skills.write_approval and memory.write_approval are separate native gates. Same-model background review inherits parent reasoning.

versionQualifiedImplementation.completion: A daemon review can start after foreground delivery. Foreground ready/idle, timeout or cancellation acknowledgement is not review completion or proof of no calls/writes. Per-agent serialization is not global writer quiescence.
versionQualifiedImplementation.triggers: Default skill nudge: 10 accumulated tool-calling iterations; default memory nudge: 10 user turns. Enabled/tool/response/interruption gates apply. This is distinct from a separately requested Curator consolidation pass.

bounds.inputTokens: Default min(75% of resolved review context, 600000), fallback 120000. Explicit max_input_tokens <= 0 means unlimited, not disabled. The check is at the next iteration; a crossing request can complete.
bounds.tools: Default review dispatch admits skills plus read_file/search_files; memory only when its trigger fires and enabled. Extra configured parent tools require separate qualification.
bounds.reasoning: The same-model path inherits actual parent reasoning; configured background effort does not override it. Do not infer live effort from disk defaults.
bounds.idleDeferral: defer:auto applies to managed local endpoints, not a general cloud/default-route idle barrier.

writes.gates: Skill and memory write approval default false/unset; approvals.mode is a different gate. Inspect current settings; this knowledge grants no change to them.
writes.scope: Inspected background deletion guards protect pinned/bundled/externally owned classes from deletion; they do not universally prohibit edit/patch/support-file writes. Native learning can change source-pinned skill content.
writes.custody: Native per-skill locks, atomic writers and mutation ledgers preserve native mutation custody. A successful write is a real file effect, not canonical-source adoption or proof that every optional scanner ran.
writes.cache: Successful native skill mutations invalidate their skill system-prompt cache/snapshot automatically. This does not authorize manual cache clearing or prove every existing context reloaded.

requiredCurrentEvidence.activity: Observe owned native review/usage and file/ledger evidence separately from foreground results; record unavailable native IDs as null. Aggregate auxiliary calls are not one fork or one iteration; zero/unknown cost is not verified billing.
requiredCurrentEvidence.pinDrift: Preserve current learning successors and third-state bytes. Reconcile exact generated/projection source ownership, independent review, accepted pins and current-byte CAS before dependent source-pinned reuse. Native management flags or write success waive no external pin or first-import guard.
requiredCurrentEvidence.adoption: Verify current installed behavior and actual loaded/adopted state independently. Do not disable learning, restart, reset caches, replay effects, add a router/loop or change approvals/models merely to reconcile observations.
